title: The parabolic Dini-$β$ condition and absolute continuity of surface and caloric measure
summary: We show if $\partial Ω$ is the graph of a parabolic Lipschitz function, then parabolic surface measure $σ$ of $\partial Ω$ is absolutely continuous with respect to its caloric measure if and only if a (square) Dini-$β$ condition is satisfied. More specifically, the (square) Dini-$β$ condition is that \[\int_0^1 \hatβ(X,t,r)^2 \frac{dr}{r} < \infty, \quad \text{$σ$-a.e. } (X,t) \in \partial Ω.\] Here $\hatβ$ is a parabolic version of the Jones ($L^2$) $β$-numbers.
